reasoning: The question asks whether fatalities in Nicaragua during Feb 20-Mar 22, 2026 will exceed 10 times the baseline (1 + 30-day average from Sep 16, 2025 - Mar 14, 2026). However, ACLED tracks organized armed group violence, battles, riots, explosions, and violence against civilians—not traffic accidents.
